reviews.comment: I didn't quite care for the subject so lectures were a lot to get through on a T/TH. She is a good professor though. Exams weren't too hard, all are written exams.

reviews.comment: Professor Brady was awesome to have this year. The class relies pretty heavily on the textbook and there are a lot of lectures and class discussions. She was very engaging and clearly cared about the material and her students. All the grades are fairly straight forward and she grades very generously.

She is an excellent professor! I took her for Philosophy of Art this year because I needed a culture credit, and she did not disappoint. The class is not very difficult if you like to read and write. As long as you do your best, you will pass. 10/10

This isnt too hard of a class but I didnt like the way she taught it. I found lectures boring and attendance is graded. We had 2 exams that were short answer and essay questions. If you study the test review you will do good enough on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Brady is such a kind woman who really cares about her subject and students. I loved her but I didnt really care for the material, so her lectures were quite boring to me. The tests were short answer and it was very difficult to finish them with the time allotted. I studied a lot but ppl in my class struggled with answering all the questions.
